connectors.name: Filesystem
connectors.description: Read and write explicitly allowed local directories.

auth.warning: The server can access the directory you provide.

connectors.installation_notes: Install with npx and provide the explicitly allowed directory when configuring the server.

connectors.name: Cloudflare
connectors.description: Manage Cloudflare resources — Workers, KV, R2, DNS, and more.

auth.warning: Requires a Cloudflare API token and account ID as environment variables — grants whatever access that token has, scope it narrowly.

connectors.installation_notes: Install with npx and configure a narrowly scoped Cloudflare API token and account ID through the environment.

connectors.name: Everything
connectors.description: Reference/test server with prompts, resources, and tools.
connectors.installation_notes: Install with npx; no credentials are required.

connectors.name: Fetch
connectors.description: Web content fetching and conversion for LLM use.

auth.warning: Can fetch arbitrary URLs — no credentials required, but network access is real.

connectors.installation_notes: Install and run with uvx; the server performs live network fetches.

connectors.name: Git
connectors.description: Read, search, and manipulate Git repositories.

auth.warning: Can read and modify the repository you point it at.

connectors.installation_notes: Install and run with uvx, pointing the server at the repository to operate on.

connectors.name: Memory
connectors.installation_notes: Install with npx; no credentials are required.

connectors.name: Sequential Thinking
connectors.description: Dynamic, reflective problem-solving through thought sequences.
connectors.installation_notes: Install with npx; no credentials are required.

connectors.name: Time
connectors.installation_notes: Install and run with uvx; no credentials are required.

connectors.name: GitHub MCP Server
connectors.description: Work with GitHub repositories, issues, pull requests, and search.
prerequisites: Official GitHub server runtime and GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN

auth.warning: Authentication required. Configure GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN using Kyrex's environment configuration before installation.

connectors.installation_notes: Authentication required. The official launch configuration requires additional environment support not representable safely by the current command/args-only MCP format; configure it manually.

connectors.name: Playwright MCP
connectors.description: Automate and inspect browser sessions using Playwright.

auth.warning: Browser automation can access sites and data available to the configured browser.

connectors.installation_notes: Install with npx. Browser binaries may need to be installed separately; no Kyrex connection test is performed in this phase.

connectors.name: Context7
connectors.description: Retrieve current, version-specific documentation for libraries and frameworks.

auth.warning: Authentication required only when the official Context7 configuration requires a key; credentials are never stored in the catalog or MCP JSON.

connectors.installation_notes: Install with npx. If the selected official server configuration requires authentication, configure it through the environment and retry; Kyrex does not collect credentials interactively.
